queries.question: Which interventions improve objectively measured facial skin texture, roughness, wrinkles, elasticity or laxity in adults with photoaging?
Does daily broad-spectrum sunscreen or photoprotection prevent or improve clinical signs of photoaging, skin texture and wrinkles in adults?
What are the comparative efficacy, dose response, tolerability and durability of tretinoin, tazarotene, adapalene, topical isotretinoin, retinol and retinaldehyde for facial photoaging and texture?
Which non-retinoid topical treatments improve objective photoaging or texture outcomes: vitamin C, niacinamide, alpha hydroxy acids, peptides, growth factors, antioxidants or topical hormones?
How do ablative fractional CO2, Er:YAG and non-ablative fractional lasers compare for facial photoaging, wrinkles, texture, durability, downtime and adverse effects?
What clinical evidence supports microneedling, radiofrequency microneedling and non-needle radiofrequency for facial texture, wrinkles, laxity and collagen remodeling?
What are the efficacy and harms of chemical peels, dermabrasion and microdermabrasion for facial texture, roughness and photoaging?
What evidence supports IPL, photodynamic therapy, red or near-infrared LED, HIFU, ultrasound and plasma devices for facial texture, wrinkles and dermal collagen?

What clinical evidence supports poly-L-lactic acid, calcium hydroxylapatite, hyaluronic acid, PMMA, autologous fat or other injectable biostimulators for skin quality, texture and collagen remodeling?
What are the efficacy, durability and safety of PRP, PRF, polynucleotides, PDRN, exosomes, conditioned media and stem-cell-derived products for facial rejuvenation and skin texture?
Do oral hydrolyzed collagen or collagen peptides improve wrinkles, roughness, dermal collagen, elasticity or hydration, and do effects persist in high-quality non-industry-funded trials?
What is the comparative effectiveness of treatments for atrophic acne scars when separated into ice-pick, rolling and boxcar subtypes?
How do fractional CO2, Er:YAG and non-ablative fractional lasers compare for atrophic acne scars by scar subtype, phototype, adverse effects and durability?
How effective are microneedling and radiofrequency microneedling for ice-pick, rolling and boxcar acne scars compared with lasers, peels or no treatment?
What are the efficacy, technique-dependent outcomes and harms of subcision alone or with suction, fillers, fat, PRP or threads for tethered rolling acne scars?
What is the comparative effectiveness of TCA CROSS, chemical peels, punch excision, punch elevation, punch grafting and dermabrasion for ice-pick and boxcar acne scars?
Which phenotype-directed combination treatments outperform monotherapy for mixed atrophic acne scars, and what sequence and interval were used?
What treatments prevent or improve hypertrophic scars and keloids, including long-term recurrence, symptoms and adverse effects?
Do silicone gel, silicone sheeting and pressure therapy prevent or treat hypertrophic scars or keloids versus placebo or usual care?
How do intralesional corticosteroid, 5-fluorouracil, bleomycin, verapamil and botulinum toxin compare for keloids and hypertrophic scars?
What are the comparative efficacy and harms of pulsed-dye laser, fractional CO2 laser, other lasers and cryotherapy for hypertrophic scars and keloids?
Which adjuvants reduce keloid recurrence after excision: corticosteroid, 5-fluorouracil, radiotherapy, pressure, silicone, cryotherapy, laser or imiquimod?
Randomized controlled trials reporting objective facial texture, roughness, wrinkle, elasticity or collagen outcomes for any anti-photoaging intervention.
Randomized controlled trials of treatments for atrophic acne scars with validated scar scores and results by ice-pick, rolling or boxcar subtype.
Randomized controlled trials for hypertrophic scars or keloids reporting Vancouver Scar Scale, POSAS, symptoms, thickness or recurrence.
Does topically applied collagen penetrate human skin or produce clinically meaningful durable improvement in wrinkles, texture or dermal collagen?
What evidence and adverse events exist for unsupervised home dermarolling or home microneedling for texture, photoaging or acne scars?
Do facial exercises, massage, jade rollers or gua sha produce durable improvements in wrinkles, facial skin texture, laxity or dermal collagen in controlled human studies?
Do topical vitamin E or onion extract prevent or improve surgical, hypertrophic or keloid scars compared with placebo, silicone or usual care?
Does recent or concurrent isotretinoin increase abnormal scarring or impaired wound healing after laser, peeling, dermabrasion or cutaneous surgery, and which procedures truly require delay?
Which interventions produce objectively measured durable reduction in facial pore appearance or size, and which only create transient optical or sebum effects?
Do apparent skin benefits of oral collagen supplements persist when trials are restricted by study quality, preregistration and non-industry funding?
What human adverse events, regulatory concerns and evidence gaps exist for cosmetic exosome, stem-cell-derived, conditioned-media, PDRN and polynucleotide skin treatments?
How do post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, dyspigmentation and scarring risks after lasers, microneedling, radiofrequency and peels vary by Fitzpatrick phototype and treatment parameters?
